q: How far in advance do I have to tell HR before my parental leave starts?
answer:
You need to agree the dates with the HR desk **at least 30 days before the leave starts**.

To apply, you also file a draft document with the family relation certificate and the parental leave form attached. It goes through your team lead, then the division head, then the HR desk. Once HR confirms, they explain how to claim the employment-insurance benefit. The company doesn't file that claim for you.

Source: the "Applying" section of the Parental leave document in RouteMind (`/v1/nodes/childcare-apply/body`).
